question: What claim about transmission is at stake in asserting that the teaching concerning the earth-moving good-eaters was told by an earth-mover?
premises: A teaching concerns the earth-moving good-eaters.
It was told by an earth-mover.
inference: The teaching concerning the earth-moving good-eaters is transmitted by an earth-mover to the beloved.
uncertainties: The distinction between bhūcarīṇām and bhūcarī is not resolved by this verse alone.
plain_english: The teaching of the earth-moving good-eaters was told by an earth-mover, O beloved.
